leadText: Shogo Sakata (Japanese: 坂田将吾 Sakata Shōgo) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Shogo Sakata (Japanese: 坂田将吾 Sakata Shōgo) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Sakata was born on January 23, 1998 in and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , voicing several Pokémon, his most notable role being that of Goh's Inteleon.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Goh's Inteleon

Cynthia's Garchomp (JN083-present)

====I Choose You! trilogy====
(M23)

===POKÉTOON===
(PT06)

====Pokémon Evolutions====
Gladion

===Video games===
====Pokémon Masters EX====
(male)

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Carbo (Dr. Stone)
Ranmaru Ai (Fairy Ranmaru)
Karin Sasaki (Fire Force)
Modaka (Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? III)
Leviathan (My Hero Academia THE MOVIE: World Heroes' Mission)
Aki Hayakawa (Chainsaw Man)
Kazekage (One Piece)
Akito Ashimine (Tsugumomo2)
